summary.text: PA12 is polyamide 12 (nylon 12). A maker sells it for humid environments where impact strength, sliding friction and wear resistance matter, and makers cite its low water absorption and dimensional stability. It is semicrystalline. On the H2C it prints at 255⁠–⁠270 °C, and makers advise drying.

items.text: Its excellent fatigue properties make it a good option for repetitive-flex applications such as snap-fit clips and closures and press-fit inserts.
Other applications include jigs, fixtures and low-volume production parts, as well as accurate prototyping of nylon 12 high-volume injection molded parts.
A strong engineering thermoplastic, it exhibits toughness and high impact strength, without being brittle.

items.text: Unfilled, resilient nylon parts when fibre reinforcement is unnecessary.
Excellent printability and dimensional stability without fillers
With its excellent chemical resistance, low moisture absorption and easy handling, it is the ideal choice for demanding 3D printing projects.

DuraPro PA12 offers significantly lower moisture absorption than PA6-based nylons (1.6% vs. typically around 9-10% at saturation), giving it better long-term dimensional stability. This makes it easier to store and print reliably, with less risk of warping from humidity.

items.text: STYX-12 is an industrial PA12 grade nylon filament which combines excellent mechanical, chemical and hygroscopic properties with printability.
This combination of properties has resulted in high-performance and industrial-grade nylon which can be printed on a wide-range of FFF/FDM 3D printers.
Superb mechanical properties
Strong, flexible, high impact resistance, high crack resistance, high scratch resistance
Excellent chemical resistance
Excellent weather and UV resistance
Outstanding dimensional stability
Very clear in its natural form (without added colorants)
STYX-12 has a very low water absorption compared to other nylons and can be printed at relatively low temperatures.
Good first layer adhesion to EasyPad + DimaFix prepared print bed
